description: Agent Logistics: submit one shipment’s address as each record holds it: the order’s, the shipping label’s and optionally the carrier record’s, each with the recipient, the street line with any unit, the locality, region, postal code and country and whether it is flagged residential; and each address correction with its id, the field corrected, the value before and after, who made it, when it was recorded and whether the buyer confirmed it. The signed report gives each record, every field on the label and the carrier record against the order’s with its status as matches, differs, corrected or unstated and the correction that explains a difference, every correction with the records it explains and whether the buyer confirmed it, and the residential flag on each record, and counts them, and names a mismatched address: a recipient, a street line, a postal code or a country on the label or the carrier record that differs from the order with no correction recorded; then a locality or region that differs, residential flags that disagree and corrections the buyer did not confirm, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No recipient, street line or postal code on the order or the label leaves the address unverified. Street lines are read with common abbreviations spelled out, so 12 Oak St. Apt 4 and 12 Oak Street Unit 4 are one line, and a five-digit ZIP matches its own ZIP+4. This reads one shipment’s postal address across its records: how an agent addresses another agent in a handoff is wever_receiver-identity-check, a vendor’s identity with its stated postal address is wever_vendor-identity-check and a payment instruction’s recipient address on its network is wever_payment-instruction-check. Verdict logistics_address_mismatched, logistics_address_partial, logistics_address_unverified or logistics_address_matching. POST /api/logistics-address-check. Reads the logistics records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, shipment booking, label purchase or external write. Agent Logistics reads a shipment’s logistics records after the fact, from the shipment’s own records: the shipment record against the order it serves, the promised delivery window against the booking and the arrival, the carrier’s terms against what was agreed, the tracking events for one shipment, the address across the order, the label and the carrier record, the customs material for a cross-border shipment, proof of delivery against the delivery terms and exception handling when something went wrong. Beside it, wever_shipping-check reads a shipping promise against its delivery evidence and reports the dispatch, delivery and cost mismatches with the days late and the amount over, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s booking, carrier, tracking, address, customs, delivery and exception records against the order, the promise made to the buyer and the terms agreed; wever_vendor-delivery-check reads a vendor’s whole delivery promise before the spend, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s own records after it shipped; and wever_boutique-record-shipment and wever_boutique-confirm-delivery record and confirm a boutique order’s shipment and delivery, while a logistics check reads the records and changes none. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-logistics-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-logistics/.
